rca of the issue: The MongoDB shell cleanup ran against localhost:27017/test_database, which is only bound to the preview backend container. The deployed production backend at hariram-ghee-shop.emergent.host connects to a different (hosted) MongoDB whose MONGO_URL is set in the production deployment environment — not in /app/backend/.env. Therefore 170 test-order documents (90 pending + 80 completed) are still visible on the live admin console and to any customer whose phone matches those historical orders. Mitigation: obtain the production MONGO_URL from the deployment config and re-run: db.orders.deleteMany({}), db.otp_requests.deleteMany({}), db.admin_otp_sessions.deleteMany({}). Then hit /api/admin/orders/pending on the deployed URL to confirm count=0.
